description: Shared estimated text-capacity fields used by text components and rendered table cells.

efficio_max_lines.description: Estimated maximum number of rendered text lines available for all items combined.

ai.purpose: Strict estimated maximum number of rendered lines available for all generated items combined. Generated content must never exceed this capacity; shorten or compact it until it fits.

efficio_estimated_chars_per_line.description: Estimated number of characters that fit on one rendered line.

ai.purpose: Estimated number of characters that fit on one rendered line. Use it together with max_lines to keep generated content within the available space.

efficio_min_items.description: Minimum number of semantic items in the generated items array.

ai.purpose: Minimum number of semantic items the generated items array must contain.

efficio_max_items.description: Maximum number of semantic items in the generated items array; it must not exceed max_lines.

ai.purpose: Strict maximum number of semantic items the generated items array may contain. Generated content must never exceed it; shorten or compact the item list until it fits. Items may wrap across estimated lines.

efficio_target_items.description: Preferred number of semantic items; guidance only, within min_items and max_items.

ai.purpose: Preferred number of semantic items. Treat this as guidance while always respecting min_items, max_items, and the shared line capacity.
